name: Sill Line, Ticked
tagline: Lit Sill Line with lines that do work: the question heads the board, the rail's name sits in a break of the lit run, the stop on To do is the tick you press, quiet weeks are a dashed run, setup is one strip, and Chat is one track with branch ticks.
concept: Lit Sill Line's greeting standing on its own Coming up rail is kept, and each graft replaces something rather than adding beside it. The question is the board's headline and the box's label, read first; the rail's name plate sits in a break of the lit run between the now lamp and the tube's stop, and 'All plans' is the buffer's label. On To do the stop on the line is the control: a ring you press to finish the task, steel to come, amber late, dashed with no day, sage once done, under a lit now rule that crosses the list. Setup becomes one strip with a short track of numbered rings, quiet weeks become a dashed length of steel between two hollow lamps, and Chat drops one track from Vera's screen with a branch tick to each family plate and a lit ring at the box. It should feel like a calm signal box at night whose lamps are also its switches.
companions: The green keeps the lit things (the mark, Send, 'planning', the now lamp and its run, the tube, the next setup ring, her newest stop, your-turn ring, focus, the row afterglow edge). Around it: slate #161c20 boards and keys (#1b242b starters, the setup strip, family chat plates), steel #58697a/#7d8fa0 rails and rings with #a7c4d8 links, a pale ink bar #86a9cc on the family's chat plates, and midnight-ink #182536 plates with the plans' cyan #70dcf4 ring kept for plans only. Amber #ffb850 is only for late (the ring and the words) and what needs a look (the setup edge and rings, Status's 'Page' half lamp and its tally line). Sage #86d9a6 is 'now', 'your turn' and a done ring.
decisions: Started from t2-track-graft's clean sheet and build.py; the grafts are one new source, src/ticked.css, appended after sill.css, plus template changes (home, _ask, tasks, chat, plans_month, plans, status, ideas). Sheet 171 KB of the 200 KB budget.

Home headline: the h1 label 'What needs planning?' moved out of the box into a headline row over the board (speaker small in the tube column, the question over the box it labels), Archivo 700 2.75rem at 86% width, 'planning' in the two-layer glow; clamp(2rem, 8.4vw) on a phone, where it is first, then the box, then the tube. The box keeps its label; the textarea is still first in Tab order after the nav.

Coming up is a station plate set in a break of the lit run (8px gap each side, on the rail's centre line), counting once ('4 coming', the same count as the Plans head). The steel rail now starts at the tube's stop and ends at a T buffer whose label is 'All plans'. The plates share the rail's width (3 or 4 columns), names balanced to two lines; the Google note sits under the plates. On a phone the plate stands beside the vertical rail at the head of the plates.

The run is drawn without its old clip-path opening: in a full-page capture Chromium dropped the animated second half of the split run. The white-hot head still runs along it on opening, so the motion is kept.

Setup cut to one strip (~56px, was 210px): amber triangle and 'Finish setting up', a track of three numbered amber rings (each the link to its own step, 44px), the first rimmed in the phosphor with the E21 halo, a T buffer labelled 'All 3 steps', and the next step as the one link in words, 'Next: choose your own password →'. Lost: the run-in descriptions of each step (still read out to screen readers on the rings).

The tick is the stop (Home's To do and the To do page): the separate checkbox column is gone; the finish_task button is a transparent 44px square centred on the rail, its ::before the 1.15rem ring (steel, amber late, dashed pewter with no day); hover fills it faintly with the tick showing, press flashes the tight phosphor halo and fades over the afterglow; focus is a 2px #6dff9c ring inset .55rem. Done rows on the To do page show a sage filled ring with a tick, cancelled a dashed pewter ring.

The margin is a timetable column: the absolute date right-aligned in tabular figures ('Sun 27 Sep') over the relative words, amber when late ('was due 5 days ago'). The lit now rule now runs the full width of the list at its place. On the To do page the row reads margin | stop | task | who | Edit, and Edit is quiet underlined text with a 44px target.

Plans month: runs of weeks with nothing on fold to one 32px row, a dashed steel line between two small hollow lamps named in a break ('26 Oct – 1 Nov · nothing on'); today's week never folds and keeps its lit run; Sat and Sun columns sit a slate step lighter; under the grid a short rail ends at a T buffer labelled 'November continues · Later →'. The Plans list draws a gap of a week or more between plans as a dashed length of the line named the same way ('10 – 16 Oct · nothing on').

Chat: the double track and navy plates are gone. One 2px steel track drops from Vera's screen tile in the head (the head's rail now spans the lede, so the line is unbroken), times hang right-aligned in a tabular margin left of it, her lines hang from her glyph stop, each family line is a 12px steel ring with a 1px pewter tick across to a slate plate with a 3px pale-ink bar; only her newest stop is lit; the track ends in a #6dff9c ring with E21 halo, 'your turn' in the margin and a lit tick into the composer. The head is tightened (2.25rem title) so Send is on the first screen at 1280x900. Below 40rem the track hides and the bubbles take the width, the family's set to the right.

Status: each lamp on the glass is named under it in VT323 (16px, the phosphor's dim strength: Chat, Digest, Lookups, Fallback; Claude, OpenAI…; Calendar, Weather, Web, Digest, Page). 'This page', still on the installer's password, is an amber half lamp on the glass and on the board, and the tally says 'needs a look 1' in amber. The tally stands beside the glass in one bezel; states with nothing in them are not drawn. I raised the brief's 11px names to 16px because VT323 at 11px is unreadable.

Ideas: the drive is right-aligned with its figures bold and units in the label colour, so hours and minutes stack; the way (S, NE…) is a column of its own; the 'No.' head is gone and the rows keep '#7' to match the line from home. A row lights its station on focus as well as hover (kept from the parent), and on tap.

Afterglow everywhere is a 2px #6dff9c edge with a 10% wash and a short outer halo, on in 0.12s and fading over 1.2s, now on the settings list rows too. The new-idea form gets a label rail: a steel line in the left gutter with a ring at each row of fields that lights in the phosphor when its field (or the field beside it) has focus. Selects take a 2px phosphor focus ring.

Phone: Send shows its word (the select narrowed to fit), the radar in the tube's foot band is 4rem, the headline question is first. The setup strip wraps to three lines (title, track, next step), not the two the brief asked for.
title: What needs *planning*? New in the tour. It invites the family to tell Vera anything that wants arranging, which is the whole job: a weekend, an idea to keep, a reminder, a calendar entry, a wish. It cannot be answered 'no' as 'Anything to plan?' can, does not presume a plan exists as 'What's the plan?' does, is not an order like 'Tell Vera what to plan.', and is not the status check heard in 'What are we planning?'. The lit word is the job and closes the line where the eye stops; at 20 characters it holds one line at 2.75rem over the box and at about 2.1rem on a phone.
strengths: Each graft replaces something: the checkbox column became the rail's own stops, the 210px setup board became a 56px strip, empty past/future weeks became one dashed line, the double track became one, and the floating 'Coming up' and 'All plans' are now the rail's plate and the buffer's label.
The question is read first and is the largest head on Home, set directly over the box it labels, while the tube still stands on the sill with its lit wire and the now lamp breathing.

To do reads like a timetable: date in tabular figures and how far off in words in the margin, amber only for late, the ring you press on the line, and the lit now rule across the list; the same row on Home and on the To do page.
Chat is calmer and clearer: one steel track, times in a margin, branch ticks to slate family plates, only her newest stop lit, and the box reached on the first screen with a lit 'your turn' ring.
Status names every lamp on the glass and stops lying: 'This page' is amber on the glass, on the board and in the tally, and zero rows are gone.
No targets under 44px on Home or Chat, smallest text 13px, no sideways scroll at 1280 or 390.
The system now holds on every main page, Settings included: every list stands on a line whose stops are its lamps or its controls, and every line ends in one buffer.
weaknesses: Home is still green-led: about 83% of its coloured pixels are phosphor, from the lit run, the tube, the glowing question and the setup ring. The grounded slate, steel and amber are smaller by area than the light.

Several things are still worked out in templates from words or the app's clock: Home's absolute due dates (only when the relative words are in days), the month's quiet runs and counts, the Plans list's gaps, Status's 'This page' state, the short lamp names and the settings lamps' states. Each should be a small field in views.py when it ships.
The run from now no longer opens with a clip-path sweep (a full-page capture dropped it); only the white-hot head runs along it on opening.
The setup strip drops each step's descriptive clause from sight (it stays in the rings' screen-reader text), and on a phone it takes three lines, not two.
On a phone the ways to start scroll sideways, so the second and third are only hinted at by the faded edge.
The page's words move: Ideas differs from today by about 33% (the line from home), To do by its margin and column heads, Home by the new title, the plate and the setup strip, Plans by its count.
The lineage is line-heavy: To do, Plans, Chat, Settings, the form and setup all carry a rail now. That is the system, but a judge who reads lines as a subway map will find one on every page.
revisions: Settings now carries the line: a 2px rail runs down the lamp column with each part's lamp as a stop, and it ends in a T buffer at What has changed, the log. Hollow and half lamps are filled with the tray so the rail does not show through them. Sign-in and security now uses the same half amber lamp as Messages and Status's 'Page', and 'Needs a look' is amber only in the words.

To do page column heads now use the rows' own grid (padding var(--px), 1fr 7rem 5.6rem, gap 0.9rem), with Due set in the margin, so Due, Thing to do and Who line up with the rows' left edges. The stacked unit beside the head's numeral ('open / 3 late', and the same on Plans and Ideas) went from 13px to 0.875rem.
To do's terminus ring and glass are now steel #7d8fa0, not lemon/amber, so on that page amber means only late.

Plans > Month: this week's line now stops at the next plan's ring (Sun 4) with no stub and no buffer in the cell. The month's one buffer is the 'November continues · Later' one under the grid. The head counts what is shown: '6 shown, 4 to come / next Sun 4 Oct 13:00'.

Chat: the day mark is now a station plate like Home's 'Coming up' (slate #161c20, steel Archivo 600 text, #36424c edge), set ON the track with an 8px break of ground either side. The stray 60px dash on the phone is gone (.tie::before/::after content none).

Light taken back where it did no job. To do's now rule is lit for its first ~14% and fades to steel by 42%, with no bloom across the row. Chat's composer keeps a plain ink-well edge with no halo at rest, and only the lit edge (no halo) while written in, so the ring, the tick into it and Send carry the light. The board's airglow went from 13% to 10%. Home's green share moved from 85% to 83%.

Home on a phone: the ways to start are one row of 44px slate keys that scrolls sideways inside itself, faded at the right edge, not an uneven 1+2 block. The tube is trimmed (tighter glass, a 3.4rem scope, a smaller title, the textarea 3.6rem), so the 'Coming up' plate is now on the first screen.

Lately added now uses To do's columns: the kind in words, right-aligned in the margin where To do has its day, the kind's ring where To do has its stop, then the title and whom it is for. It has the same row height, divider and phosphor afterglow. The two panel heads now say their links the same way: the one thing to act on, a steel dot, then All N.
The new-idea form's label rail now ends at its last stop (it had a 10px tail under 'Add it').

Declined: making 'From' visible on the phone. It is already there as a visually hidden label for the select (track.css), so the field is labelled for a screen reader. Showing it would push Send off the row, and the select's own 'who is asking?' says what it is.
Declined: dimming the past plates on the month further. Pho Oregon and Silver Falls already have hollow lamps and dim ink, and the head now counts all six, so the count and the grid agree.
